findings.title: Preserve permission-denied errors across the mobile microphone bridge

evidence.detail: A denied native microphone prompt throws UnauthorizedAccessException.
Host serializes only the exception message.
Every failed host call becomes an ordinary Error.
Permission guidance is selected only for DOMException named NotAllowedError.

findings.trigger: Deny the microphone permission prompt on iOS, or keep the app's microphone access disabled in system settings, then start dictation.
findings.impact: The UI shows the generic connected/available microphone error instead of the existing instruction to allow access in system settings. Retrying the same action does not explain how to recover.
findings.recommendation: Return a stable permission-denied code through the existing host bridge and map it to dictation.permission, keeping generic device and transport errors distinct.
findings.validation: Mock native permission denial through the actual shim contract and assert dictation.permission; verify denied and subsequently enabled permissions on an iOS device.

checks.command: Static mobile manuscript picker / Apple speech contract review
checks.detail: Read manuscript security-scope picker, native Swift speech and microphone code, iOS/macOS targets/build script, C# AppleSpeechBridge/SystemMicrophone and renderer capture consumer. No Apple toolchain/device execution on Windows.

coverage: No additional independently confirmed native functional defect was found beyond the parent audit's lifecycle/scope/path/transport/CI findings. Hardware route-change, audio-session restoration and cancellation race hypotheses were deliberately withheld.

novalist-pnp: inventory, manifest, csproj dependency/deploy configuration, contributor declarations/native view factories were inspected; no deep RPG, encounter, import, Owlbear, PDF, build or test audit.

novalist-qwentts: inventory, manifest, csproj dependency/deploy configuration, contributor declarations/native view factories were inspected; no deep legacy Python/model/playback/voice-store audit or build.

Legacy compatibility was compared with current SDK/host and gallery; neither old extension appears in the current gallery. Current Speech is a separate extension. Both legacy repositories remained read-only.
